description: Sets, replaces or clears the photo of the host on the registration page and in the registration animation. Take it when the face on the page is wrong or missing. A host says: "There is no picture of me, use the one from the media library." It needs the session and the webinar, plus one of three things: an image from your media library, a WordPress user whose avatar should be used, or a clear instruction to remove the photo. It writes on your site and participants see the new face on their next visit. The site reads the stored photo back, so report only what the answer names. Never invent an image address. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: my photo, host picture, add a face, remove the picture

clear.description: true removes the photo, so the site shows the avatar or a monogram instead.

media_url.description: The image to use, from the host's own media library.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

wp_user_id.description: Use this WordPress user's avatar as the host photo.

name: wi_change_host_photo
title: Change the host photo of a webinar
